exact.原理：Web 墨卡托投影在纬度 φ 处把面积放大约 1/cos²φ 倍（相对赤道: How it works: Web Mercator inflates area by roughly 1/cos²φ at latitude φ (relative to the equator). At 60° the same patch of land looks 4× larger than at the equator; at 80° it reaches 33×. This map recalculates the factor in real time from the centre latitude after you drag.
